## Fresh final scope, governing basis and independence

This is a fresh final whole-change reassessment of the complete engineering diff from ffb58ecb2b8879926eaa1db0784761768ffb303e to 24c92999e8cd16d61e942a6b6a9f5100a1e064ab, with current attributable proof/routing suffix through cd527586. It includes all M1/M2 interactions and both final corrections. Prior milestone approvals are evidence of their scopes, not substitutes for this integrated judgment. Approved proposal, Design r3 and Delivery r3 govern the exact corrected package and unchanged plan allocation. Earlier r2 Design/Delivery and final-r1 assessments preserve original subjects/judgments; current approval is not inferred by retargeting them.

The reviewer authored none of the engineering, tests, generated metadata, archive dispositions, narratives or corrections. Previous Design/milestone/final-review work by this actor was assessment only. This invocation reviewed the actual corrected diff, current package basis, applicable proof and all integrated conclusions afresh. No engineering, plan, activity or work state was changed.

Primary full-subject inspection binds current engineering subjects; current evidence and governing review records are explicit fresh reads and are referenced by record/entry identity in this body. They are not relabeled as immutable engineering subjects. All 34 final-correction-proof engineering identities were independently checked and match current bytes. ## Integrated contract, pilot and source assessment

The final common owner contains actionable retained rules, not just topic references: required metadata/profile, role fields and two-line summary, stage vocabulary, authoritative vocabulary presentation and scoped approved reference equivalents, output skeleton completeness, public-text coverage/contributor exclusions, recognized resource-loading prefixes, failure/temporary-exception conditions, immediate new/changed versus inventory enforcement, raw-byte transformations and full-read escapes. Their original populations and approved supersessions remain explicit. The amended applicability opening is now stable conditional intent; reviewed implementation and successful Verify still gate adoption. No universal audit, non-pilot normalization or customer adoption is claimed.

The actual supported candidate ordinary-author path supplies purpose, target/operation, classification, existing seven-section proposal asset and optional material impact without requiring storage construction. The formal independent review path supplies complete proposal/intent assessment, exact scoped context and subject identities, current review/finding construction, authority/recording/continuation separation and core/durable/formal result groups. Automated and specialized groups remain conditional; adopted assessment precedence comes from the existing complete policy resource, with the unadopted portable scope rule preserved. Required late-loaded methods stop without invention; untriggered absence is distinct from valid packaging. The useful improvement is earlier task/resource selection and complete self-contained conditional construction, not a token claim or repeated asset extraction.

The final validator/resource/candidate composition continues to protect all four combined Design hazards. Exact pilot references are selected independently of the removed heading, with body triggers and explicit missing/unreadable/escaped/unknown failures; unrelated complete content cannot rescue the selected path. Current placement remains v2. The ordinary and formal paths reach the unchanged reviewed assets and shared methods in actual candidate archives. All 11 pilot resource files were independently compared across each of Codex, Claude Code and opencode; their bytes match canonical sources. Of 137 canonical files, exactly the four intended pilot files changed and 133 remain unchanged. Current archive metadata/index and Gate B evidence remain applicable because these inputs did not change during final corrections. No live customer or release claim follows.

Current governance, System and selected mixed architecture portions point to the common Skill owner while preserving Workflow, Review and Closeout, Test, Record Format/CLI, distribution, installation and release responsibilities. The mixed Skill Contract retains R37–45/R56–63 with scoped supersessions and historical rollout context. Four archive snapshots preserve original bytes; source-path copies and 73 source-resolved navigation targets preserve readable history. No operational resource or complete directory moved. FU-015–018 explicitly allocate all 17 remaining capabilities with receiving owners/differences/next decisions, and FU-012 retains separate validation consolidation. The integrated source-to-package chain does not silently expand the pilot.

The eight stage-owned narratives remain fully preserved with original paths/raw-byte hashes in registered evidence entries. Historical removed-note subjects remain original observations; current reliance is on preserved text plus current engineering proof. No previous approval is rewritten. Historical source assertions now identify archive history, while current-owner and actual production-validator regressions retain useful detection. The final lifecycle test correction changes only the stale asset lookup to the existing Design-owned legacy architecture skeleton; all 16 section obligations and the original equality assertion are retained.

## Actual proof composition and checks

Inspected final command: bash scripts/ci.sh --mode pr --base ffb58ecb2b8879926eaa1db0784761768ffb303e --head 24c92999e8cd16d61e942a6b6a9f5100a1e064ab --timeout 1200 --jobs 4. It exits zero with Selected CI checks passed, boundary 15.58s and focused 387.28s. The recorded table includes passing schema/model/boundary, skill/generation/drift, adapter, lifecycle regression/validation, current change-record, guide, prose, selector, CLI and npm-package checks. In particular, full lifecycle regression passed in 95.20s and exact-current-head lifecycle validation in 116.14s. The focused repaired case also passed. Reviewer independently matched the final log hash f8003bdf98247935e2bd7a2ebb7a7c802427c46e541b354df29db95578b82958 to the recorded result.

The original broad invocation remains failed. Its aggregate had exactly two failed children and ten successful children, with no missing results. The lifecycle regression child is replaced by the actual complete corrected run. The legacy changed-root adapter rejection is not called a pass: current v2 roots are validated by the supported exact-head lifecycle/record path, and the documented --skip-diff-scoped mode establishes that the legacy dirty-root invocation is not mandatory for this supported composition. That alternative mode was inspected, not falsely reported as executed. The ten actually successful broad children are listed with commands and unchanged dependency/environment basis in final-correction-proof. Canonical skills/resources, generation/packaging, production validators/schema/CLI and their dependencies did not change after that run; changed model prose and fixture input receive fresh checks. Final CI additionally reruns relevant skill/generator/adapter and current record checks. No overall broad-run pass is claimed and no failed child is hidden.

Reviewer actually performed exact diffs, source/candidate/proof reads, primary context/full-subject inspection, current identity comparisons, candidate raw-byte and canonical-diff checks in the final assessment, log hash comparison and record-only suffix inspection. Unchanged prior source/archive/consumer assessments are reused with explicit identical-byte basis; this final judgment is fresh. The reviewer did not rerun successful expensive suites merely to manufacture evidence. Evidence references are final-correction-proof, design-final-wording-correction, m2-correction-integration and preserved-m1-procedure-walkthrough in the current registered evidence file, with their stated limits.
